# From the root of acme/api

# If .trailguide/config.yaml has schemaVersion: 1,
# rewrite it as version 2 first: https://trailguide.fabricahq.com/reference/configuration/#no-backward-compatibility

# acme/api already imports fabricahq/public-rules as team.
# In .trailguide/config.yaml, add to sources.team.rules.include:
#   - practices/testing/*
#   - techs/go/return-errors

trailguide project sync

trailguide project add rule practices/testing/keep-tests-independent \
  --from team@1.0.0 \
  --reason 'We maintain our own version of this rule.'

trailguide project add rule techs/go/close-bodies \
  --from https://github.com/fabricahq/code-rules-test-library.git@1.0.0

trailguide project build

# Then make sure AGENTS.md tells agents to read .trailguide/_managed/generated/RULES.md
